statement: A Delaware corporation must file its annual franchise tax report and pay the franchise tax on or before March 1 each year (8 Del. C. § 502(a), § 504(a)); failure to file a complete report by March 1 adds a $200 penalty plus interest, and a corporation whose prior-year liability was $5,000 or more pays tentative quarterly installments (40% by June 1, 20% by September 1, 20% by December 1, remainder by March 1).
caveat: Amounts, thresholds, and computation methods (authorized shares vs assumed par value capital) change; the Division of Corporations' default bill often overstates tax that can be recomputed under the assumed-par-value method. This repo does not compute the tax or extend the deadline — verify against the live statute and agency page.
